summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, added a CHANGELOG entry, and updated tests/test_progress.py. Changes: track() gains a trailing show_speed=True option passed to TaskProgressColumn; TaskProgressColumn gains show_speed=False, a static render_speed(speed) method, and a render() branch for unknown totals; Progress.track declares task_total as Optional[float] and no longer raises for unsized iterables. Tests: added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the ValueError assertions from test_track and test_progress_track. Not verified: I did not run the tests or the strict mypy check, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
